thread_title: Find a post from the last 3 days: How do I stop scrolling my phone in bed?
thread_summary: Look for someone who loses sleep to late-night scrolling and wants a fix.
text: What works for most people is changing the setup rather than relying on willpower. Charge the phone outside the bedroom or across the room, and get a cheap alarm clock so there's no excuse. Pick a fixed phone-down time, say 30 minutes before bed, and swap the scroll for something easy like a paper book or a shower. The first week is the hard part. After that, falling asleep tends to get quicker, partly because you stop pushing bedtime later one video at a time.
